notes.title: We will be holding a demo for "Dolls Nest" at TOKYO GAME SHOW 2025!
notes.content: [p]At the NITRO PLUS booth (Hall 11 Indie Game Area C-25), you'll be able to try out "Dolls Nest," a customizable 3D action game currently on sale.[/p][p]Come experience the world of "Dolls Nest," where you control a mecha girl  to explore  the gigantic factory world of Hod and discover the mysteries of the world that await you![/p][p][/p][p]Those who try out the game will receive a giveaway item.[/p][p]*Supplies are limited, and distribution will end once they are gone.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872200/af1145e609d45083258c3444e68d6e473c89f8b8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]*Depending on how busy it is, we might have to limit how long you can try out the game.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Event overview[/h3][table equalcells="1" colwidth="192,"][tr][th colwidth="192"][p][b]Event Name[/b][/p][/th][td][p]TOKYO GAME SHOW 2025[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="192"][p][b]Period[/b][/p][/th][td][p]Business Day: Sep. 25-26 1000-1700[/p][p]Public Day: Sep. 27 930-1700 | Sep. 28 930-1630[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="192"][p][b]Venue[/b][/p][/th][td][p]Makuhari Messe Hall 1~11 + International Conference Hall + Event Hall[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="192"][p]Links[/p][/th][td][p][url="https://tgs.cesa.or.jp/en"]TOKYO GAME SHOW 2025 Official Site[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.m-messe.co.jp/en"]Makuhari Messe[/url][/p][/td][/tr][/table]

notes.content:
An update has been made to correct the following issues.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[*]Fixed an issue where body shape could not be changed using gamepad controls on the "EDIT HUMANOID" screen.
The key bindings for the "Body Hape Change" and "Switch Display" functions have been changed.
[*]Fixed an issue where changes to body shape information were not saved on the "EDIT HUMANOID" screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Restoring corrupted save data
notes.content:
This text has been automatically translated. Please understand.

We have received reports of an issue where the game crashes and then the error message "LowLevelFatalError|File:Unknown) [Line: 729]" is displayed, making it impossible to launch the game.

The reason for the error message is that the save data may have been corrupted when the game crashed and the game cannot be started.

We apologize for the inconvenience, but we would like to investigate and repair your save data, so please send us your save data folder by email using the procedure below.

*If you contacted us by April 30, 2025 regarding corrupted save data, we apologize for the inconvenience, but please contact us again with your save data.

We will investigate the save data, and if we are able to resolve the issue, we will return the repaired save data to you.

[h3]Check the save data folder[/h3]
[olist]
[*]On the desktop screen, hold down the "Windows" key and then press the "R" key on your keyboard.
[*]A window titled "RUN" will appear.
Enter "%localappdata%/DollsNest" in the search window and select "OK".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872200/d99a1fa9a6fbd5a6138e223605065492e432fb8a.jpg[/img]

[*]This will open the save data folder.
The opened "Saved" folder is your save data, so please compress the folder using any application and send it to the email address below.
*When repairing your save data, the "number of Cycles" information will also be corrected, so please let us know [b]the number of Cycles in your save data[/b] as well.
[/olist]
[b]Please send Save Data here[/b]
Nitroplus User Support Email Address
[url=steam_support@nitroplus.co.jp]steam_support@nitroplus.co.jp[/url]

[b]Attention[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Depending on how corrupted the save data is, it may not be possible to repair it.[/b]
[*]Please note that we may not be able to handle cases where save data has been damaged intentionally or due to phenomena not caused by the game.
[*]When repairing save data, the following information may not be restored.
"SAVE DATA NAME"
"PLAY TIME"
"CYCLES"
[*]Please note that it may take some time to investigate and repair the save data.
[/list]

If you are unable to repair your save data, or if you do not wish to repair it and would like to be able to play the game again, please see "About deleting save data" below.

[hr][/hr]

[h3]About deleting save data[/h3]

If the save data is corrupted, an error will occur when starting the game or loading the save data.

We apologize for any inconvenience, but if corrupted save data cannot be repaired, you will need to delete the save data and play the game in its initial state.

Please follow the steps below to learn how to delete your save data.

[olist]
[*] Turn off the Steam Cloud feature
If the Steam Cloud function is ON, even if you delete corrupted save data,the corrupted save data stored in the cloud will be re-downloaded.
Before deleting save data, turn off saving save data to Steam Cloud.

・Open the "Library" in the Steam app, right-click on "Dolls Nest" and select "Properties".

・Once the properties are open, go to the "General" menu and change the "Keep game's saves in the Steam Cloud for Dolls Nest" option to "OFF." 
*The default setting is probably ON (blue).

This will turn off Steam Cloud save storage.

[*] Delete save data
Please open the local save data folder using the following steps.

・On the desktop screen, hold down the "Windows" key and then press the "R" key on your keyboard.

・A window titled "RUN" will appear.
Enter "%localappdata%/DollsNest" in the search window and select "OK".

This will open the save data folder.
The "Saved" folder in the opened folder will be your save data.
The save data will be invalidated if you delete it or rename it to a different file name such as "Saved_00".

[*] Start the game
This completes the deletion of your save data.

Launch "Dolls Nest" from the Steam app and check if the game starts without any errors.

If you are able to start the game normally, you can safely turn the "Keep game's saves in the Steam Cloud for Dolls Nest" option back to "ON".
[/olist]
[hr][/hr]

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by our products.

We look forward to your continued support of Nitroplus.

Nitroplus Co., Ltd.

notes.title: Dolls Nest (Ver 1.0.3）Updates
notes.content:
An update has been made to correct the following issues.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Crashes occurring during screen transitions have been addressed.
[*] Fixed an issue where the important resource "Her Ethereal Vestige" was disappearing.
[*] Fixed a problem in which settings loaded in presets were not reflected in certain operations.
[*] Fixed an issue where status effect was not applied correctly when attacking after upgrading some weapons.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Crashes during screen transitions[/h3]
In this update, we have made some adjustments to the part that we believe is causing the [b]screen transition crash[/b].
Crashes caused by screen transitions have been reduced, but it is still possible for a crash to occur while playing.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may caused to our customers.
We will continue to investigate and address the cause of this crash issue.

If you experience crashes while playing the game, it may be possible to improve the situation by changing the graphics settings in the environment settings as shown below.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but please change the settings and continue playing.
[list]
[*] Please change the frame rate setting from "unlimited" to an upper limit such as "60" or "120".
[*] Please change your graphics settings from "Highest" to "High" or "Medium".
[/list]


[h3]Regarding the disappearance of the important resource "Her Ethereal Vestige"[/h3]
The issue was resolved in "Ver1.0.2" released on 2025/04/25, but with this update we have made a change so that items can be reacquired only for data that is currently experiencing the issue.
Users who have lost the "Her Ethereal Vestige" due to the progress of the event are asked to reacquire it by following the steps below.

[olist]
[*] Please transfer to "Decayed Broodchamber" from the Node Tree menu.
[*] After transferring to the "Decayed Broodchamber" there is an open item box near the central container.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872200/84d4b9006accfd3dddf96bf4e465d7a08d0be85d.png[/img]
[*] Obtaining this item will allow you to obtain "Her Ethereal Vestige" again.
[*] After obtaining the item, [b]once you have moved to the Frame Loadout or another map[/b], talk to "Nema" in the "Decayed Broodchamber" to see if the event proceeds.
*Other items will also be required to progress through the event.
[/olist]


* The following is not included in this fix, but please check it if you experience any issues.

[h3]Regarding the issue where the animation was canceled and items could not be acquired when acquiring a "Code Fragment"[/h3]
When all the important resources “Code Fragment α” “Code Fragment β” and “Code Fragment γ” are obtained, a effect will occur.
However, if this effect is cancelled for some reason, such as transition or death, the items that would have been obtained after the staging may not be obtained correctly.

In this case, if another item is obtained or purchased in the store after the problem occurs, the effect will occur again and the item will be available normally.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but if you encounter any problems, please obtain some items.

notes.title: Known Bugs(2025/4/26)
notes.content:
Currently, the following issues have been confirmed.
We are currently investigating these issues and plan to fix them in a future update.

[b]・Crashes during screen transitions[/b]
The game crashes when switching between screens that require loading, such as "Frame Loadout" or "Config".

[b]・The important resource "Her Ethereal Vestige" disappears[/b]
Currently, there is a bug that causes the important resource "Her Ethereal Vestige" to disappear, hindering the progress of the game's story.
We believe that this issue occurs as a result of progressing through the event involving the NPC "Shara."

[b]*The issue where the "Her Ethereal Vestige" disappears can be resolved by applying the Ver1.0.2 update (released after 22:00 on April 25, 2025), so please be sure to apply the update.[/b]

If the issue has already occurred, we plan to issue a patch to allow players to obtain the key resource "Her Ethereal Vestige" again.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause to our players, and thank you for your patience.
